creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 13, item 5.

`body` comes back decoded whenever the response text parses as JSON, judged by content rather than Content-Type. Downloading a `data.json`, or a `.txt` holding `123` or `true`, returns a map or a number, and the exact bytes are gone; `to_json` re-serializes with sorted keys and its own whitespace. On main a mocked body `{"b": 1,  "a": 2}` comes back as `map { "a": 2, "b": 1 }`, and `123` as an int. The script falls back to curl for any file that looks like JSON.

A named arg such as `raw=true` would cover it; not decoding when Content-Type isn't JSON would be a better default.

Where: `core/requester.go:107` `TryConvertJsonToNativeTypes`.
title: http_* decode any JSON-looking body, with no way to get the raw response text
